## Problem and user workflow

Which existing baseline or new use case motivates the proposal?

## Primary sources

Link to author papers / official documentation and specify reviewed version.

## Supported assumptions and outputs

Model class, actions, uncertainty, policy, objective, representations.

## Guarantees and limitations

Feasibility, optimality, approximation direction, validity/error assumptions.

## Integration and evaluation

Affected contracts, dependencies, resource/threading behavior, and
comparison against a compatible reference. Separate measured results
from expected benefits.
